author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Going live on Twitch, YouTube, and more at the same time from one OBS setup is way easier than you think. In this video, I walk you step-by-step through how to use the Aitum Multistream plugin to multistream directly from OBS Studio without paying for third-party services or extra cloud encoders.

By the end of the video, you’ll be able to:
   - Stream to multiple platforms at once from OBS
   - Keep full control of your encoding settings per platform
   - Avoid monthly fees from cloud multistreaming services by running everything locally in OBS

Host: Tim Seneker
#OBS #streamer #multistream #Aitum
